Label, bounds, track with filled span, two handles, end labels, reason named and shown.
One Range variant used by farrowing.room.
Default, pressed (dragging), focus, at limits, disabled (grey fill, dashed handles, reason), error, long/zh rendered; data-dragging set on a live drag.
Handles 48x48, staggered so equal bounds stay grabbable.
Not a choice control; the copied five-row rule is gone.
Selection carried by handles and written value as well as the fill; disabled has a reason.
zh value '昨天 – 3天后' stays on one line; the long label wraps above it.
role=slider; aria-valuetext uses format ('4 days ago', 'In 7+ days'); arrows/Home/End and track tap verified.
Tokens only (--green, --disabled-border; README token list misses them, see findings).

Links FilterSheet, FilterChips, ChoiceList, PickerField, Sheet.

variants.name: Range
findings: Mouse drag, keys and track tap update value text, fill and aria-valuetext together; handles never cross; 0-result range blocks the sheet commit.

round1.finding: Raw negative value text, no formatter

round1.note: fill is --green; the design-system README colour law lists green for 'done, recorded, synced, selected', so a selected span in green is within the law. Not reversed.

findings.text: Label and formatted value run together with a capital mid-line: 'Due In 7+ days', 'Due 4 days ago – In 7+ days'.
findings.fix: Set the value on its own line under the label so the formatter's sentence case reads as a value.

findings.text: If the owner's 'green = approved/done only' rule is meant to override the README, the green span conflicts; the README names selection green, so it passes today.
findings.fix: Owner decides: keep the README, or switch the fill to --ink and drop 'selected' from the green law.

findings.text: README token list omits --green and --disabled-border, which the fill now uses.
findings.fix: Add both to the API and tokens line.

findings.text: zh end label '7天以后' drops the open-ended '+' that 'In 7+ days' and '7天以上前' carry.
findings.fix: Use '7天以上后' in the zh formatter.
